summary: Add st-select, a local shadow-only tool that reports whether a change leaves the Rust test stage's inputs unchanged

replay.detail: Developer scripts only (scripts/st-select, its Rust plugin and its controls); no daemon, claim or replay code changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness change. No CI workflow, skip policy or merge-queue change reads the tool's output; its optional signed record uses the check name select.linux-gate, which no policy names.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state; removing the scripts restores the previous behavior.
